fieldValues.title: titleFieldId fallback carriage check + recordWrapper single-emission fold
fieldValues.summary: RFC-020 Revision 7 (srs#731) widened [N+37]'s heading-fallback trigger from 'section declares no titleFieldId' to 'the record's Type's effective field set doesn't carry it' — a heterogeneous contains/discovery tree can hold sibling records whose Types don't all carry the section's titleFieldId. Implements that in srs-rust and folds srs-rust#1012 (recordWrapper double-heading emission) in the same PR since both bugs live in the same function.
fieldValues.body:
Dispatched from srs-rust's gate:dispatched queue (srs#580's queue) — Epic 16 U4 per the master thread's classification comment (srs-rust#1011 comment 5623923408), executed per the same comment's verbatim constraints. Prerequisite U3 (srs#731, RFC-020 Revision 7) had merged at 16:14Z; the schema mirror (srs-rust#1035) was already in.

Fix: `resolve_heading_field_id` (crates/srs-repository/src/render_service.rs) now checks `Package::effective_fields(rt)` for carriage of an authored `titleFieldId` before accepting it; when eligible-but-not-carried, falls back to `effective_identity_field_id`, same as the titleFieldId-absent case. [N+1] ineligibility (owner ruling, srs PR #341) still omits without fallback, unchanged and covered by its own untouched test.

Fold (#1012): moved the `record_wrapper` lookup in `render_record_at_level` above the heading-push, gated the renderer's default heading emission on `record_wrapper.is_none()` — a theme's `{{record-heading}}` placeholder in `recordWrapper` no longer gets a duplicate default heading inside `{{content}}`.

Two required red tests proven red pre-fix, green post-fix (output in PR comment): `title_field_id_omitted_silently_for_record_lacking_field` (rewritten from a shallow no-crash assertion into a real one) and its JSON-projection mirror; `heading_omitted_when_type_has_title_field_but_record_value_empty` (new) stayed green throughout, proving the discriminator is field-carriage, not the record's own value. Added `record_wrapper_heading_is_emitted_exactly_once` for the #1012 fold.

Verification: built this branch's binary and re-rendered a fresh `srs` origin/master clone through `publish-spec.mjs`/`validate-all.mjs` — zero `docs/spec/**` diff, matching srs#731's blast-radius claim that this repository's own corpus never reaches the fallback.

Gates exit 0: cargo build --workspace, cargo test --workspace (zero failures, SRS_SPEC_DIR fresh clone), cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings.

Land: PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs-rust/pull/1036, gate:auto-merge armed (not hand-merged). Mode complicated, Cell Conformance, Door 1 (executes RFC-020 Revision 7, srs#731).
